reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse an UNSTRING COUNT IN identifier-6 or TALLYING IN identifier-8 that does not reference an integer data item (a numeric item with no digit positions right of the decimal point, §1985:III.2) or whose PICTURE uses 'P' - so a V or P picture, an alphanumeric, numeric-edited, index or group item, and a reference-modified item (which is alphanumeric, §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR2) are all refused - while admitting any-usage signed or unsigned integer items and subscripted integer table elements.

reader.notes: StrUnstrIsInteger reads p.Item.Pic, the BASE item's PICTURE, so a reference-modified identifier-6/identifier-8 over an integer item passes the screen and the emitter then splices a long into a string image, which Roslyn refuses. Sibling, same predicate: WITH POINTER PN (1:2) (UNSTRING SR5, c5d.cob) fails the same way (CS1503), and STRING WITH POINTER uses the same StrUnstrIsInteger. PB5384 fixed this shape for SEND and IntrinsicResultType.IsIntegerOperand but not here.
